generated_for: deployment tooling and CI compatibility checks

telegram_gateway.notes: No database access: talks to Backend over /internal/v1/telegram only.

rules: Frontend changed -> Telegram Gateway is not redeployed.
Backend changed with a compatible contract -> Telegram Gateway is not redeployed.
Telegram Gateway contract changed -> Gateway requires its own deployment.
Equal git SHA or equal version across components is never required.
Worker restart does not affect Backend or Gateway: retry state lives in PostgreSQL.
Component versions are independent: compatibility is decided by contract_version, not by matching versions.
Telegram Gateway has no DATABASE_URL and no access to the Backend network segment.
